property: the internal sector of the 2I-covariant Clifford cell: chirality conservation of the 32-internal step, its pseudoscalar sector blocks and their relation to the 16-sector step, the committed CPT operator against every candidate the cell offers, the unchanged anomaly and trace-form data, and the grid-converged loop return amplitude F_n against the spinless control
status: INTERNAL SECTOR AND LOOP RETURN OF THE 2I-COVARIANT CLIFFORD CELL at the closed clock g = 0.785398 (layers 1, internal exponent 4). (T1) the 32-internal step commutes with 1 (x) w to 7.1e-31 at the probe momenta: the bond layer acts on direction, layer and spinor and does not leak into the internal factor. (T2) in the pseudoscalar eigenbasis the step is block diagonal to 2.9e-16 and its 16-block is spectrally the 16-sector step to 4.0e-15 -- the reuse of U16 is a consequence -- and the matter and antimatter blocks are isospectral to 3.8e-15: CPT on the spectrum survives the bond layer. (T3) the CPT candidates, worst defect over the probe momenta -- control (scalar bonds, same clock and internal exponent): P g1 S(q) g1^-1 (P g1)^-1 vs S(-q) = 5.0e-16, g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S(-q) = 1.2e+00, g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S(-q)^T = 1.2e+00, P g1 S(q) g1^-1 (P g1)^-1 vs S(-q)^T = 1.2e+00, g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S_inv(-q) (internal inverted) = 1.3e+00, g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S(-q)^-1 = 1.4e+00, so 'P g1 S(q) g1^-1 (P g1)^-1 vs S(-q)' holds at 5.0e-16; Clifford cell: g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S(-q) = 1.1e+00, g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S(-q)^-1 = 1.1e+00, g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S_inv(-q) (internal inverted) = 1.1e+00, P g1 S(q) g1^-1 (P g1)^-1 vs S(-q)^T = 1.4e+00, g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S(-q)^T = 1.4e+00, P g1 S(q) g1^-1 (P g1)^-1 vs S(-q) = 1.4e+00, so the best is 'g1 S(q) g1^-1 vs S(-q)' at 1.1e+00 and none holds: the identity the committed CPT operator has to satisfy fails exactly where V225 T1 measured inversion broken (1.414 at the zone centre). (T4) the 5/3 trace-form ratio stays 1.6666666667, the 8 anomaly coefficients stay zero (largest 2.2e-16) and the sector dimensions 32 = 2 x 16: the internal data are untouched. (T5) the loop return F_n on the momentum ball is [0.0, 0.460082, -0.0, -0.334407, -0.0, -0.293981, -0.0, 0.212037, -0.0, 0.208772, 0.0, -0.180884] for n = 1..12: the odd lengths vanish in modulus to ['3.3e-18', '5.8e-18', '6.5e-18', '7.8e-18', '8.3e-18', '8.6e-18'] -- the split is exact, not a real-part artefact -- while the even lengths are resolved at [] and not at [2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12] (refinement changes ['0.0e+00', '3.1e-02', '9.1e-19', '3.4e-02', '2.0e-19', '5.4e-02', '4.6e-19', '7.5e-02', '1.0e-18', '8.4e-02', '9.6e-19', '2.3e-01']), against [-0.218513, -0.539918, 0.31623, -0.174733, 0.02754, 0.233438, -0.207769, 0.134859, -0.010502, -0.162805, 0.161383, -0.120024] for the matched scalar-bond control. The bond layer kills the odd returns, so the loop factor of Section 12 has to be recomputed on this cell, and at these grids no converged even-length value is available to recompute it from.
